# This is directory for Nordic EdgeAI Lab solution generated files

I've munged the model included here to avoid exposing the specifics of my keyboard.  However, you're welcome to hack your own :)

Check the resources directory, within I've included the randomtyper and keycapture, so install the keycapture app on the DK, adjust the mic pin/method as required by your local setup, and capture a few sessions to train.
